description.value: Versante Hotel is Richmond BC's only independent luxury boutique hotel, a 100-room, 15-storey property minutes from Vancouver International Airport that has earned rankings among Canada's top luxury hotels by Condé Nast, Tripadvisor, and U.S. News & World Report. The hotel features bold, art-forward design with bespoke commissioned pieces in the lobby, a rooftop pool, 24-hour fitness room, and complimentary airport shuttle van. Attached restaurant Bruno and on-site dining make it a distinctive overnight option for cyclists passing through the Richmond/YVR corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Versante Hotel is an operating luxury boutique hotel at 8499 Bridgeport Road, Richmond BC, with phone +1 604 242-7777 corroborating the OSM-discovered contact details. The website explicitly lists free high-speed Wi-Fi in all rooms and references an attached restaurant (Bruno) for on-site dining. No mention of bike storage, bike handling procedures, laundry, drying areas, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone +1 604 242-7777 sourced from website only.
